detailed_descriptions.en: Step onto golf’s biggest stages and prove you can rise among the greats. Compete in the ultimate test: The PGA Championship, The U.S. Open, and The Open Championship make their PGA TOUR 2K debut. Rise through the ranks in an expanded MyCAREER, where every round builds your legacy. Create your path to greatness with new MyPLAYER customization, upgraded Skill Trees, and advanced Course Designer tools. Then take your shot against the best in ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer. You didn’t show up for second place. GRAB A CLUB. CHASE GREATNESS. Team up or face off in Match Play, Scramble, or Skins - online or local. Compete in cross-platform societies, earn seasonal rewards, and rise through daily and weekly tournaments. ON GOLF’S BIGGEST STAGES Take on legends like Tiger Woods or step into their shoes and feel what it’s like to master some of the hardest courses in the world. In a PGA TOUR 2K franchise first, test your grit at The PGA Championship, U.S. Open and The Open Championship. YOUR CAREER. YOUR LEGACY. YOUR WAY. Dynamically simulate rounds, train for tournaments, and evolve your player through new Attribute Point and Equipment Progression systems. SEASONS. BACK AND BETTER THAN EVER. Earn rewards, climb the Ranked leaderboards, and experience regular content updates. Progress at your own pace through past Seasons. PGA TOUR 2K25: AIM FOR GREATNESS

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Step onto golf’s biggest stages and prove you can rise among the greats. Compete in the ultimate test: The PGA Championship, The U.S. Open, and The Open Championship make their PGA TOUR 2K debut.

Rise through the ranks in an expanded MyCAREER, where every round builds your legacy. Create your path to greatness with new MyPLAYER customization, upgraded Skill Trees, and advanced Course Designer tools. Then take your shot against the best in ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.

You didn’t show up for second place.

GRAB A CLUB. CHASE GREATNESS.

Team up or face off in Match Play, Scramble, or Skins - online or local. Compete in cross-platform societies, earn seasonal rewards, and rise through daily and weekly tournaments.

ON GOLF’S BIGGEST STAGES

Take on legends like Tiger Woods or step into their shoes and feel what it’s like to master some of the hardest courses in the world. In a PGA TOUR 2K franchise first, test your grit at The PGA Championship, U.S. Open and The Open Championship.

YOUR CAREER. YOUR LEGACY. YOUR WAY.

Dynamically simulate rounds, train for tournaments, and evolve your player through new Attribute Point and Equipment Progression systems.

SEASONS. BACK AND BETTER THAN EVER.

Earn rewards, climb the Ranked leaderboards, and experience regular content updates. Progress at your own pace through past Seasons.

PGA TOUR 2K25: AIM FOR GREATNESS
